title: A link rotating at a pivot 120 mm from an earlier kerf, before the rotation fact
rationale: Until the rotation model is a fact, each rotation step is checked as the full disc of radius R_rot + rho = 459 mm about the pivot (safety-model 9.3; PHYS-07). Cut k ends 120 mm below cut b's start, inside r_min - rho = 156 mm: the annulus used for translations never reaches it, and an in-place turn about the tool would not cross it, but a turn about a point between the tool and the support centroid can bring the rear support to 66 mm from the tool. Both pivots (the end of k, the start of b) fail; the nearest removal is the end of k in either case.
